description: This file defines the DeviceHandler class in Kotlin, responsible for collecting and reporting device-specific information such as battery status, storage, network, permissions, and health metrics. It includes various helper functions to assemble JSON payloads with device status and info, check permissions, and interpret hardware states.

classes.name: DeviceHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for retrieving device status, info, permissions, and health data, and generating JSON payloads.

classes.name: BatterySnapshot
classes.description: Data class to hold battery status parameters such as level, temperature, and charging state.

methods.name: hasAnySmsCapability
methods.description: Checks if SMS capabilities are enabled and available.

methods.name: isSmsPromptable
methods.description: Determines if SMS permission prompts should be shown.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with current device status details such as battery, storage, network, and power info.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo
methods.description: Provides device model, system version, app version, and locale information.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions
methods.description: Returns current permission statuses for various device features.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth
methods.description: Gathers device memory, battery, power mode, and security patch info.

methods.name: statusPayloadJson
methods.description: Constructs JSON with battery, thermal, storage, network, and uptime info.

methods.name: infoPayloadJson
methods.description: Creates JSON containing device and app build details.

methods.name: permissionsPayloadJson
methods.description: Assembles JSON with permission states and access rights.

methods.name: healthPayloadJson
methods.description: Builds JSON with device memory, battery, power, and system information.

methods.name: readBatterySnapshot
methods.description: Reads current battery status and metrics.

methods.name: batteryLevelFraction
methods.description: Calculates battery charge level as a fraction.

methods.name: mapBatteryState
methods.description: Maps battery status codes to descriptive strings.

methods.name: mapChargingType
methods.description: Converts battery plugging types to descriptive strings.

methods.name: mapThermalState
methods.description: Translates thermal status codes to human-readable states.

methods.name: mapNetworkStatus
methods.description: Converts network capabilities to connection status strings.

methods.name: permissionStateJson
methods.description: Creates JSON object representing permission grant status and promptability.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has a specific Android permission granted.

methods.name: mapMemoryPressure
methods.description: Determines memory pressure level based on total and available memory.

methods.name: networkInterfacesJson
methods.description: Generates JSON array of current network transport types.
